title: A Docker container keeps restarting or has stopped

steps.say: Why it stopped. exit=137: killed (oom=true means for memory). exit=143: stopped by a signal. exit=1: the app failed; see its log.
steps.cmd: docker inspect -f 'status={{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} oom={{.State.OOMKilled}} restarts={{.RestartCount}} error={{.State.Error}}' <CONTAINER>

steps.say: Its last log lines: the app's own error is usually here.
Health check results, if it has one (null means none).
Memory and CPU use now, against its limit.
A full disk stops containers too.
After fixing the cause (compose file, .env, disk), start it again from its compose folder.
steps.rollback: docker compose down stops it again.

steps.say: It should stay Up, and the restart count stop rising.
